hero.title: General Contracting
hero.body1: Amr Ali Contracting & General Trading Company provides general contracting services for residential, commercial, administrative and industrial projects, through integrated solutions that cover every stage of construction, from site preparation and structural works to finishing and final handover.
hero.body2: We deliver projects through careful planning, coordination between engineering disciplines, and close follow-up of each stage of work, while adhering to the approved drawings, technical specifications and the agreed schedule.
hero.scopeLead: We provide integrated services for executing a wide range of structural and architectural works, tailored to the nature and requirements of each project.
scopePoints: Coordination and follow-up of execution and handover stages.

items.title: Industrial & Logistics Projects
items.body: Factories, warehouses, workshops, production facilities and industrial administrative buildings.
